properties.name: Retire dep:dynograph-foundation — the dependency it declares no longer exists
properties.rationale:
🛑 A DISCIPLINE SLIP, RECORDED RATHER THAN QUIETLY FIXED: this ChangeEvent was written AFTER the code, unlike increments 1-3 where it preceded the edit. The impact-check skill says record first, and the reason is not ceremony — the blast radius is meant to be the work list, and computing it afterwards means it described work already done. Nothing was harmed here because the plan node already carried the scope, but the ordering was wrong and saying so is cheaper than pretending otherwise.

⭐⭐ THE FINDING WORTH MORE THAN THE MIGRATION — absorbing a `#[non_exhaustive]` type converts a RUNTIME FALLBACK into a COMPILE-TIME GUARANTEE. Two wildcard match arms became unreachable: `keys.rs` had `_ => None` and `vocabulary.rs` had `other => "<unsupported endpoint>"`. Both existed ONLY because the enums lived in another crate — `#[non_exhaustive]` has no effect inside the defining crate. `vocabulary.rs`'s own comment said *"a variant added UPSTREAM must not silently read as matches-nothing"*, and after today there IS no upstream. Both arms were removed, so a new `Value` or `EdgeEndpoint` variant is now a build error instead of a string a reader has to notice. **Nothing in the plan predicted this, and it is a genuine improvement rather than a cost.**

🛑 THREE MECHANICAL TRAPS, EACH CHEAP AND EACH INVISIBLE TO THE GATE THAT SHOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT:
① INTEGRATION TESTS ARE SEPARATE CRATES. The blanket rewrite turned `dynograph_core::Value` into `crate::foundation::core::Value` everywhere — right inside the lib, wrong in `tests/*.rs` where `crate::` is the test binary. 12 files needed `reflow2_core::` instead.
② `props!` IS `#[macro_export]`, so it lives at the CRATE ROOT, not in the module it is written in. `crate::props`, never `crate::foundation::core::props`.
③ **`--no-default-features` CLIPPY DOES NOT COMPILE FEATURE-GATED FILES.** The identical `props!` error sat in `fulltext_tests.rs` behind `#[cfg(feature = "fulltext")]` and passed that gate THREE TIMES, surfacing only when the workspace suite enabled the feature. Same shape as increment 2's `#[cfg(test)]` defect: **a gate trusted for coverage it structurally cannot provide.** CI runs both forms and would have caught it; the local habit of reading the narrow gate as the wide one is the actual defect.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
The final increment of `dec:absorb-the-foundation-subset-and-end-the-dependency`. `dynograph-core`, `dynograph-storage` and `dynograph-text` are absorbed at tag v0.12.0 into `crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/` — 7,869 lines across core/ (schema, value, error), store/ (backend, cache, keys, engine/*) and text.rs — with their tests. 62 files were rewritten, plus 12 out-of-crate test files.

**THE DEPENDENCY IS GONE, VERIFIED THREE WAYS:** `cargo tree -p reflow2-core` and `-p reflow2-mcp` both report zero dynograph crates; `Cargo.lock` holds zero; no manifest names one. The only mention left was a stale crate DESCRIPTION ("...over dynograph-foundation"), now corrected.

The seven external crates that came with it are declared in reflow2's own `[workspace.dependencies]` for the first time: `rocksdb`, `tantivy`, `rmp-serde`, `lru`, `serde_yaml`, `uuid`, `thiserror`, plus `tracing` which nothing had declared. `rocksdb` stays at **0.24 verbatim** per `dec:absorb-rocksdb-024-unchanged-then-switch-separately`.

⭐ THIS MODULE IS PUBLIC WHERE THE OTHER THREE ABSORPTIONS ARE NOT. `stats`, `fuzzy` and `graphalg` are `pub(crate)` on the ground that `ifc:core-api` records 277 public functions growing by default. That argument does not reach here: `lib.rs` already re-exported `DynoError`, `Schema`, `Value`, `StoredNode` and `StoredEdge`, and `reflow2-mcp` names `DynoError` 35 times and `StoredNode` 21 times. Making them private would be a breaking change dressed as tidiness.
